title: Great Inventions
description: A short text about inventions that changed our lives.
instructions: Read the text about great inventions. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 💡 An invention is something new that someone makes for the first time. Some inventions are small, but they change our lives. Let's find out about four great ones.
The first one is the light bulb. Before it was invented, people used candles and lamps, which were not very bright. In 1879, Thomas Edison made a light bulb that could shine for a long time.
The second is the telephone. Alexander Graham Bell made the first telephone in 1876. Before that, if you wanted to speak to a friend in another town, you had to write a letter or visit him.

The third is the aeroplane. In 1903, the Wright brothers flew a plane for the first time. It stayed in the air for only twelve seconds. Today, planes carry millions of people across the world every day.
The fourth is the computer. The first computers were so big that they filled a whole room! Now we have small computers in our pockets, which can take photos, play music and help us with homework.
Not all inventions were made by famous people. A girl called Becky made a pair of gloves with lights when she was ten years old. She wanted to help people to ride bicycles safely in the dark.
Inventors usually fail many times before they succeed. Edison said, 'I haven't failed. I've just found ten thousand ways that won't work.' He never gave up, and that is why he is famous.
What would you like to invent? Maybe you can make a robot that cleans your room, or a bag that carries itself. If you have a good idea, you should write it down today!
